note: All 13 reported patients across two studies (12 in Ramond et al. 2023 and 1 in Shatokhina et al. 2023) harbor variants clustering in the 5' coding region/RS1 domain upstream of the alternative start site.

evidence.text: Ramond et al. identified 12 individuals from 11 families whose predicted loss-of-function variants clustered in the 5' part of TRA2B upstream of an alternative translation start site, increasing the expression of the noncanonical Tra2β-3 isoform lacking the RS1 domain.

source.title: Clustered variants in the 5' coding region of TRA2B cause a new neurodevelopmental syndrome
source.quote: All variants clustered in the 5' part of TRA2B, upstream of an alternative translation start site responsible for the expression of the noncanonical Tra2β-3 isoform.

evidence.text: A second study described the 13th patient, harboring a de novo c.170+1G>A splice variant in the RS1 domain leading to exon 2 deletion, consistent with the previously reported cohort.

source.title: TRA2B Gene Splice Variant Linked to Seizures and ...
source.quote: The proband harbored a de novo c.170+1G>A variant in the RS1 domain of Tra2β, which was confirmed to be pathogenic through mRNA analysis, resulting in exon 2 deletion and a frameshift (p.Glu13Valfs*2).
